name: Spaceship 7f22824b on 4.8.8
description: A period-4 spaceship on the truncated square tiling 4.8.8 (touching neighbours), 7 cells, moving two lattice steps every 4 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 512 rules from B2/S2 to B245678/S25678; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 9 times). It contains a perturbed phase of the smaller ships 78d55497 and bde55795. To our knowledge not reported before.
